title: Pentax response lengths control stack allocation and unbounded fixed-offset decode
summary: Severity medium; confidence high; functional/security input-boundary finding. indigo_drivers/ccd_pentax/indigo_ccd_pentax.c:551-568,582-596,605-613,621-655 obtain a uint32 length from camera readiness, allocate uint8_t buffer[length], pass length to the uint16 pentax_read argument at503, and decode identity/firmware/full-state offsets without a minimum payload check. Oversized replies can exhaust the stack; short or length-truncated transfers can leave the subsequent fixed offsets outside valid input. The SCSI helper399-447 also does not require an exact data-stage count before accepting CSW success. Distinct from active020 and021 (open/readiness). Minimal fix: bounded response storage, exact transfer count, reject unsupported lengths before allocation/narrowing, validate all model-state offsets against received bytes; fake USB short/large status regressions. Source-only evidence, no adversarial fixture or reproduction executed. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (AC-9). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
